title: API: create refuses a blank number, a missing description, a 256-character number and a library id alone
custom_preconds: • API calls replayed from DevTools with header X-Location-ID = your location; a category id and default bin id.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/inventory/parts/create with partNumber " " and a description.
  2. Same with a new partNumber and no description (and again with description " ").
  3. Same with a 256-character partNumber.
  4. POST a body with only catalogPartId (no partNumber, no description).
  5. Search Inventory for the numbers used.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 400 "Part number is required."

Step 2:

  • 400 "Description is required." both times

Step 3:

  • 400 "Part number must be at most 255 characters long."

Step 4:

  • 400 with "Part number is required." and "Description is required."

Step 5:

  • Nothing was created.
